subject: Renewal amendment & staged activation plan — 8→16 GPUs
body:
From: Alec Turner <alec@nebulaai.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase: moving from 8→16 GPUs

Hi Priyom,

We're approaching our annual renewal and want to accelerate the ramp to support a new product spike. Current reserved pool is 8 GPUs. We want to move to 16 GPUs at renewal, effective Nov 1. Can you send an outline of the commercial tradeoffs, activation timing, and any required amendments? Two things we care about: predictable monthly commit (for budgeting) and a 99th percentile latency throughput warranty for burst traffic.

Also looping ops@nebulaai.com for any technical constraints.

Thanks,
Alec
Alec Turner
Head of Platform Engineering
Nebula AI

---

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Alec Turner <alec@nebulaai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase: moving from 8→16 GPUs

Hi Alec — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can expand your Dedicated reserved pool to 16 GPUs at renewal and include an updated monthly commit. Below is a high-level summary; attached is a draft amendment (NebulaAI_Amendment_v3.pdf) and a checklist (SOW-activation-checklist.xlsx).

Summary (high level)
- Current: 8 GPU reserved pool, rolling monthly commit $X/month
- Proposed: 16 GPU reserved pool, new monthly commit $2.9X/month (15% volume discount off list for 2x capacity); includes burst buffer of 2 GPUs for 30-day activation window while we bring capacity online.
- SLA/throughput: we can commit to a throughput guardrail tied to 99th percentile tail latency for your peak step sequences (we'll map to qps per GPU once we confirm profile). Penalties scoped in amendment for repeated violations (credit-based).
- Activation timeline: capacity staging over two weeks (Nov 1–Nov 14) with phased testing windows.

Next steps I propose:
1) Review attached amendment and sign via DocuSign (link in the doc).
2) Karthik will confirm ops plan and expected activation checkpoints.
3) Marissa will confirm commercial numbers and finalize invoice proration for Nov.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if you prefer to walk through the tradeoffs.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Nebula AI amendment — pricing and proration check

Priyom / Karthik,

I reviewed the draft amendment. Commercial notes:
- Proposed monthly commit is calculated as baseline commit * 2 minus a 15% discount. That yields $2.9X/month. Will need Legal to confirm the exact invoicing code for reserved capacity vs. burst credits.
- We should offer a 90-day price protection window (no step-up) if they sign by Oct 20 — reduces their procurement risk.
- For proration: billing for Nov should charge 50% of the higher commit if activation completes mid-month; we will include a one-time onboarding credit of $5k to offset switchover costs.

Ops question for Karthik: can we guarantee the 99th percentile throughput SLA across AZs or only per-AZ? Also need an ops playbook for prefix caching configuration during the ramp.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nebula AI amendment — pricing and proration check

Short answers:
- SLA: We can provide the 99th percentile throughput guarantee per-region (US-west) where the customer's pool is pinned. Cross-AZ redundancy exists but the SLA should be scoped to the pinned pool to keep the measurement clean.
- Activation: two-week staged activation. Week 1 — bring 4 additional GPUs online in canary mode with traffic shifted to validate KV-cache warmup and batching behavior. Week 2 — bring remaining 4 GPUs online, run full-rate soak. We recommend a blue/green cutover window to avoid cold-cache latency spikes.
- Ops items in SOW checklist: prewarm prompts, KV cache snapshot, batch size caps, and rollback runbook. I added notes to SOW-activation-checklist.xlsx.

I can attend the call with Alec; propose Wed 7 Oct 14:00 PT.

Karthik
Head of Inference Ops

---

From: Alec Turner <alec@nebulaai.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: ops@nebulaai.com, legal@nebulaai.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase: moving from 8→16 GPUs

Thanks — the summary looks good. A couple of clarifications before we sign:
1) Can you confirm the monthly commit number in USD (we operate in USD).
2) We want the 99th percentile throughput SLA scoped to the pooled capacity (not per-GPU). If it is per-region/pool that's acceptable; we can't accept per-AZ carveouts that reduce efficacy during burst.
3) Please confirm whether onboarding credit applies if activation completes on Nov 1 vs Nov 15.

We can take the Wed 14:00 PT call. I'll invite our operations lead (Maya) and legal counsel for a quick 20-minute sync.

Regards,
Alec

---

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Alec Turner <alec@nebulaai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase: moving from 8→16 GPUs

Alec — answers inline: 
1) Monthly commit in USD: $290,000/month (reflects 15% volume discount on 2x list). We will break out line items on the amendment.
2) We can scope the 99th percentile throughput SLA to the pooled capacity in the US-WEST region (i.e., the 16 GPU reserved pool). We'll remove per-AZ carveouts from the SLA language; Legal will draft the precise measurement method.
3) Onboarding credit: customer receives $5k onboarding credit if activation completes on or before Nov 10. If activation completes after Nov 10 but before Nov 30, credit is $2k.

Call confirmed Wed 7 Oct 14:00 PT. DocuSign link is in the amendment if you want to pre-sign.

Best,
Priyom

---

From: Alec Turner <alec@nebulaai.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: ops@nebulaai.com, legal@nebulaai.com
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase: moving from 8→16 GPUs

Thanks all — call was helpful. We're aligned on USD $290k/month and the US-WEST pooled SLA. Please remove the per-AZ language and add the $5k/$2k onboarding credit thresholds. Legal will review the amendment and aim to return redlines by Friday Oct 9. We'll sign after Legal confirms.

Alec

[Attachments referenced: NebulaAI_Amendment_v3.pdf (attachment), SOW-activation-checklist.xlsx (attachment)]
